title: 第二章 废武魂与先天满魂力（一）
content_zh:
老杰克对唐三显然很有耐心，在他心中，村里最懂事的孩子就莫过于眼前的唐三了，真难想象，那样一个父亲怎么会有这么一个乖巧的儿子。
“大魂师是魂师级别的称号。魂师是我们整个斗罗大陆中最高贵的职业，他们可以是强大的战士，也可以拥有出色的辅助能力。但不论是哪一种魂师，级别都是按照同样的称号进行排序的。”
“魂师都拥有自己的武魂力，根据武魂力的强弱，一共分为十大称号。每一个称号又分为十级。最初刚刚入门的，叫做魂士，只要武魂觉醒之后，每个人都是魂士。如果武魂能够修炼的话，当魂力达到十一级的时候，就会进入下一个称号，也就是魂师。而大魂师，就是整个称号序列中的第三个。达到了大魂师境界，就已经是一名相当强大的魂师了。总体的十个称号是这样的。”
“魂士，魂师，大魂师，魂尊，魂宗，魂王，魂帝，魂圣，魂斗罗和封号斗罗。我们斗罗大陆的名字，就是由此而来。传说中，达到九十级以上的封号斗罗都可以自行给自己取一个封号，他们简直就是无敌的存在啊！”
眼中闪耀着骄傲的光辉，“我们圣魂村百年前可是出过一个第八等称号的魂圣哦。在整个诺丁城，甚至整个法斯诺行省，也是极为少有的。”
一旁的唐昊撇了撇嘴，“老杰克，那只是一个传说而已。”
仿佛被触动了逆鳞一般，老杰克大怒，“什么叫传说，传说也是从事实而来。唐昊，你来村子也有六年的时间了，应该明白那位魂圣在我们心目中的地位。再让我听到你侮辱魂圣大人，我就驱逐你离村。要不是看在小三的份上，你以为我愿意来你这狗窝么？”
唐昊却不动怒，依旧敲打着手中的农具，就像是没听到杰克的话似的。
杰克狠狠的瞪了他一眼，这才向唐三道：“以后你可千万别像你爸爸这么颓废，好了，我先走了，三天后，我来接你。”
说完，老杰克怒气冲冲的离开了铁匠铺。
“爸爸。”唐三叫了一声。
“嗯？”唐昊冷冷的瞥了他一眼，看到父亲眼中的寒意，唐三不得不将想说的话咽了回去。低着头回他自己的房间继续奋斗那一万次敲击去了。
夜幕降临，吃过晚饭，唐昊抹了抹嘴，习惯性的朝外面走去，对于他来说，这是例行公事，出去喝酒。喝最劣质的麦酒。
“爸爸。等一下。”唐三来不及收拾碗筷，先叫住了唐昊。
“干什么？”唐昊不耐烦的瞪了他一眼，尽管唐昊从没有打过唐三，但不知道为什么，唐三天生就对这位父亲有些畏惧。对于两世为人的他来说，也无法改变这种感觉。
“那一万下，我锻造完了。”唐三说道。
“哦？”唐昊眼中的光芒似乎亮了几分，“拿来给我看看。”
“好。”唐三快步跑回自己的房间，很快，他捧着一个铁块跑了出来。
铁块通体乌黑，虽然形态并不规则，但看上去每一个断面都极为光华，其中乌光隐现。整个铁块大约是原本铁坨的四人之一大，唐三运起玄天功拿着它才不觉得吃力。
唐昊将乌黑铁块抓入手中，放在自己眼前仔细的看了看，“现在你明白我说的话了么？”

唐三点了点头，“百炼成钢，品质再差的金属经过不断的锻造提纯，也会变成优质。爸爸，你是要告诉我这个道理么？”
唐昊发现，这些天自己的儿子似乎带给自己不少惊讶，将铁块还给他，“那你就继续吧。等你把它锻造成拳头大小时，再拿来我看。”说完，他转身就走出了家门。
按照他原本所说，锻造那铁块一万下就可以教唐三锻造，但现在他似乎是食言了。但唐三却并没有在意这些，他只是想着唐昊说的话。
“拳头大小？”这么大的铁块，真的能够锻造到拳头大小么？尽管只有原本体积的四分之一，但唐三却很清楚，随着不断的锻造，铁块的密集程度越来越大，体积缩小也就变得更加困难。想要把它锻造到只有拳头大小的程度，绝不是再来一万下敲击就能做到的。
百炼成钢，那么万炼又是什么呢？唐三眼中闪过一道闪亮的光芒，脚下微微一错，身体已经灵巧的钻入到自己的房间中去了。很快，叮叮当当的敲击声，再次在铁匠铺中响起。
三天的时间很快就过去了，唐三每天早晨依旧会到山顶上去做他的例行功课，回家之后，除了做饭以外，就是锻造。算是和那块生铁较上了劲。每天的敲打速度都在增加。玄天功帮助他很快的恢复体力，得以维持这不断的锻造过程。
“小三，爷爷来接你了。”老杰克准时来到了铁匠铺，或许是因为对唐昊的厌烦，这次他甚至没有走进去，只在外面叫着唐三。
唐三看了一眼身边刚刚吃过早饭的父亲。唐昊冷淡的道：“去吧。别耽误了中午做饭。”
content_en:
Old Jack was obviously very patient with Tang San. In his heart, the most sensible child in the village was the Tang San in front of him. It was really hard to imagine how such a father could have such a well-behaved son.
"Great Soul Master is a title at the soul master level. Soul masters are the most noble profession in our entire Douluo Continent. They can be powerful warriors or have excellent auxiliary abilities. But no matter what kind of soul master they are, their levels are sorted according to the same title."
"Soul masters all have their own martial soul power. According to the strength of the martial soul power, they are divided into ten titles. Each title is divided into ten levels. Those who have just started to get started are called soul masters. As long as the martial soul awakens, everyone is a soul master. If the martial soul can be cultivated, When the soul power reaches the eleventh level, it will enter the next title, which is the soul master. The great soul master is the third one in the entire title sequence, and it is already a very powerful soul master. "
"Soul Warrior, Soul Master, Great Soul Master, Soul Lord, Soul Sect, Soul King, Soul Emperor, Soul Saint, Soul Douluo and Titled Douluo. This is where the name of our Douluo Continent comes from. According to legend, Titled Douluo who have reached level 90 or above can choose a title for themselves. They are simply invincible existences!"
His eyes were shining with pride, "Our Holy Soul Village produced an eighth-level Soul Saint a hundred years ago. It is extremely rare in the entire Notting City, and even in the entire Fasno Province."
Tang Hao on the side curled his lips, "Old Jack, that's just a legend."
As if his scales were touched, Old Jack was furious, "What is a legend? Legends also come from facts. Tang Hao, you have been in the village for six years, and you should understand the status of the Soul Saint in our hearts. If I hear you insult the Soul Saint again, I will expel you from the village. If it weren't for the sake of the mistress, do you think I would be willing to come to your doghouse?"
Tang Hao didn't get angry, and still banged the farm tools in his hands, as if he didn't hear Jack's words.
Jack glared at him fiercely, and then said to Tang San: "In the future, you must not be as decadent as your father. Okay, I'll leave first. I'll pick you up in three days."
After saying that, Old Jack left the blacksmith shop angrily.
"Dad." Tang San called.
"Huh?" Tang Hao glanced at him coldly, and seeing the coldness in his father's eyes, Tang San had to swallow back what he wanted to say. He lowered his head and went back to his room to continue fighting for those ten thousand knocks.
As night fell, after dinner, Tang Hao wiped his mouth and walked outside as a habit. For him, this was a routine, going out to drink. Drink the worst ale.
"Dad. Wait a minute." Tang San stopped Tang Hao before he could clear away the dishes.
"What?" Tang Hao glared at him impatiently. Although Tang Hao had never beaten Tang San, for some reason, Tang San was born with some fear of his father. For him, who has lived in two lifetimes, he cannot change this feeling.
"After ten thousand strokes, I've finished forging it." Tang San said.
"Oh?" The light in Tang Hao's eyes seemed to be a little brighter, "Bring it to me and see."
"Okay." Tang San quickly ran back to his room, and soon he ran out holding an iron block.
The iron block is completely black, and although its shape is irregular, every section looks extremely radiant, with a dark light looming in it. The entire iron block was about one-fourth the size of the original iron lump. Tang San used the Xuan Tian Gong to hold it without feeling any difficulty.
Tang Hao grabbed the black iron piece in his hand, put it in front of his eyes and looked at it carefully, "Do you understand what I said now?"
Tang San nodded, "Steel is made a hundred times, and no matter how bad the quality of the metal is, it will become high quality after continuous forging and purification. Dad, are you going to tell me this truth?"? "
Tang Hao found that his son seemed to surprise him a lot these days, so he returned the iron piece to him, "Then continue. When you forge it into the size of a fist, bring it to me. "After that, he turned around and walked out of the house.
According to what he originally said, he could teach Tang San how to forge the iron block ten thousand times, but now he seemed to be breaking his promise. But Tang San didn't care about this, he just thought about what Tang Hao said.
"The size of a fist? "Can such a large iron block really be forged to the size of a fist? Although it is only a quarter of its original volume, Tang San knows very well that with continuous forging, the iron block becomes denser and denser, and it becomes more difficult to reduce its size. To forge it to the size of a fist, it is definitely not something that can be achieved by tapping it ten thousand times.
Steel can be made into steel if it is tempered a hundred times, but what is it if it is tempered ten thousand times? A gleam of light flashed in Tang San's eyes, his feet moved slightly, and his body had already slipped into his room dexterously. Soon, the clanging sound of knocking sounded in the blacksmith shop again.
Three days passed quickly. Tang San would still go to the top of the mountain to do his routine homework every morning. After returning home, besides cooking, he would do forging. It's like competing with that piece of pig iron. The speed of the strokes increases every day. Xuantian Kung helped him quickly recover his physical strength and was able to maintain the continuous forging process.
"Xiaosan, grandpa is here to pick you up. "Old Jack came to the blacksmith shop on time. Perhaps because he was tired of Tang Hao, this time he didn't even go in, he only called Tang San outside.
Tang San glanced at his father who had just had breakfast beside him. Tang Hao said coldly: "Go. Don't delay cooking for lunch. "
